verdict.rationale: Floot's core product is natural-language app building — described as turning plain-language descriptions into full-stack apps, operable entirely from AI chat (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) via MCP tools like query_database, get_logs, create_checkpoint, generate_image, and natural commands like "make this a mobile app." This directly matches the ai-native/agenticness story of operating via natural-language commands. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of natural-language command reliability beyond first-party docs.
